text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went out to buy a 
magazine, I ran into Fuji Kiseki and Zenno 
Rob Roy.
choice_data_list: That's an unusual combination.
That's an unusual combination.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Today, you see, I'm playing the big 
sister for Rob Roy."
choice_data_list: Miss... what do you mean???
Miss... what do you mean???

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm... About when I first came here—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The bookstore's location is... still a 
ways ahead. I wonder if there are any 
signed copies from the author left...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Fancy places like this really don't 
suit me at all~...

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, glasses girl over there~! Care 
to buy a jar of happiness~?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, well, I have something I need to 
do...

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, don't be like that~♪ It's in a 
building right nearby, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Sorry to keep you waiting, 
Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you waiting for your sister? Hey, 
hey, do you want to come check out this 
Vase of Fortune with me~?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, the two of us are on our way to my 
mother's workplace—the police station—to 
drop off something she forgot...

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter A
text_block_list.text:
T-The police!? ...I see. Well, that can't 
be helped then. What a shame~♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You really saved me... I wouldn't have 
been able to turn them down on my own...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's no trouble at all! Still, to see you 
in a place like this... Is there a book 
you can only find around here?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I heard that signed copies from my 
favorite mystery author were available, 
so...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see... Say, I have a quick favor to ask— 
would you mind accompanying me to the 
bookstore?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I had books I wanted to buy, and I 
couldn't help but worry about letting my 
"cute little sister" go alone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, big sis here ended up serving as 
her bodyguard on the way to the bookstore.
choice_data_list: Then I'll protect Fuji!
Then I'll protect Fuji!
True, you almost could pass as sisters.

Yeah, I can see how you two could be 
mistaken for sisters.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, big sis here ended up serving as 
her bodyguard on the way to the bookstore.
choice_data_list: Then I'll protect Fuji!
Then I'll protect Fuji!
True, you almost could pass as sisters.

Yeah, I can see how you two could be 
mistaken for sisters.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer-san... wants me...?
choice_data_list: Hey, I am older than you, you know!
Hey, I'm still older than you, you know!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... So then, Trainer, you're going to 
be my big brother?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... So then, Trainer, you're going to 
be my big sister?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. That'll make shopping even 
more fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After arriving at the bookstore and 
safely finishing Zenno Rob Roy's 
shopping—"
choice_data_list: Huh, where's Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I've been saaaaying, debut with 
our agency and you're guaranteed to be a 
smash hit!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for the generous offer, but 
my mind is made up—
choice_data_list:
Do you need something from my little 
sister?

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you this girl's brother? I was 
just scouting your little sister for the 
entertainment industry~!

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you this girl's sister? I was just 
scouting your little sister for the 
entertainment industry~!

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
She told me she'd rather choose the racing 
world over show business, but... you think 
the entertainment industry would be 
better, right, mister~?
choice_data_list:
No, I want to respect my little sister's 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
She told me she'd rather choose the racing 
world over show business, but... you think 
the entertainment industry would be 
better, right, miss~?
choice_data_list:
No, I want to respect my little sister's 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
"No waay~!? You're saying the glamorous 
showbiz world suits her way better than 
gritty racing~?!"
choice_data_list: Her dream lies in racing, so...

text_block_list.name: Female Promoter B
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Siiigh, alright, fine. It'll be 
too late to regret it later, got it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Scouted for the entertainment industry...? 
That's Fuji-senpai for you...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, things like that are usually 
borderline scams. Besides—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My dream lies in racing... and that's why. 
Thank you, Brother, for affirming the path 
I've chosen.
choice_data_list: You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My dream lies in racing... and that's why. 
Thank you, Sister, for affirming the path 
I've chosen.
choice_data_list: You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, my older brothers and sisters are 
truly wonderful people.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, my older sisters are truly 
wonderful people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—by the time we took a break at a 
café and returned to the academy, night 
had completely fallen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, you were a huge help today! If it's 
alright with you, please let me thank you 
next time...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I have to head back too... As 
much as I hate to part, I suppose my time 
with you is over for now, Big Brother.
choice_data_list:
If you want, I can be your big brother 
anytime.

If you want, I can be your big sister 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I have to head back too... As 
much as I hate to part, I suppose my time 
with you is over for now, Big Sister.
choice_data_list:
If you want, I can be your big brother 
anytime.

If you want, I can be your big sister 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. But next time, I'd like 
to be the one escorting you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was happy you protected me today... but 
honestly, I want to be the one showing you 
how cool I can be.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Especially to Big Bro, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Especially to Big sis, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When she tilts her head with that 
mischievous look, I have no choice but to 
nod. —Because I always want to make all 
her wishes and dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I mentioned that their hair and eye 
colors were so similar they could easily 
pass as sisters—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... That's far too much praise. 
Someone like me couldn't possibly compare 
to the wonderful Fuji-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'd be thrilled, you know? If I had a 
little sister like you, every day would be 
so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can talk with Rob Roy about plays, and 
your interpretation of the story is quite 
fascinating, after all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...! I also... find 
talking with you so fun, Fuji-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored. Well then, shall we head to 
the bookstore together like good sisters?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—since we were headed to the same 
place, I ended up going to the bookstore 
with the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I finally managed to get it...! Thank 
you both so very much!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's good to hear. Hey, do you two still 
have some time to spare?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's a live viewing of my mother's 
stage play happening right now. Would you 
like to come with me?
choice_data_list: Sounds like fun, let's go!
Sounds like fun, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes. I want to see it too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after arriving at the cinema, the 
three of us enjoyed the stage play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's mother remained immensely 
popular, and her performance on this 
occasion, too, touched the hearts of the 
audience deeply.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was a wonderful play, wasn't 
it? If possible, I'd love to see the vow 
scene just one more time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree...! That scene implying 
the canyon wolf was her late mother's 
reincarnation was just so incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That wolf did? I see... In that case, the 
duel scene takes on a whole different 
meaning."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki seemed full of life as she 
shared her impressions. It seemed Zenno 
Rob Roy's presence was having a positive 
influence on her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um, is something the matter? Is there 
something on my face...?
choice_data_list:
No, I just hope you'll stay good friends 
with Fuji from now on.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. If Rob Roy wouldn't mind, 
I'd love to watch a play together again 
and share our thoughts on it.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-If you're really okay with someone like 
me, I'd love to...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They seemed like an unusual pair at 
first, but after spending time together, 
it felt completely natural—they truly were 
like sisters."
